text:
Alex: Quick release-train update — v3.5.0 rollout planned this week.
Alex: Freeze window starts WED 23:00 PT (no merges to main after that). Patch-only via `release/v3.5.0` branch.
Alex: Canary traffic will begin THU 09:00 PT, full ramp targeted by THU 13:00 PT if canaries are green.
Alex: Key asks: hold noncritical schema changes, tag any urgent fixes with `hotfix/` and ping this thread.

ReleaseBot: release/v3.5.0 branch created at commit abc1234. Canary jobs scheduled: canary-1 (10%), canary-2 (30%), canary-3 (70%).

Marta: Question — embeddings-model switch (quant-2 -> q4f16) included in this deploy or next? Any expected latency blips?

Ben: Marta: embeddings migration is in this rollout but gated. We only flip model in canary-3. Expect transient p50 +15-30ms while caches rewarm; p99 unaffected in our perf runs.
Ben: Rollback criteria for the model flip: if 3/5 canary buckets exceed p50 threshold of +50ms for >5m OR error rate >0.5% instant rollback.

Sasha: Ops note — we'll run a warmup job between canary-2 and canary-3 to prepopulate prefix cache. Command:
```
./infra/warmup --model embeddings-q4f16 --shards 8 --parallel 4
```

Marta: Thanks — can you add me to the warmup run so I can monitor quality metrics?

Ben: Added. Also tagging @Oncall for the golden signals watch during ramp (latency, errors, tail-kv miss spikes).

Oncall: I'll be on duty Thu 08:30-14:30 PT. I'll post a short runbook snapshot here 30m before canary.

Alex: Docs + rollback knobs (for folks who need them):
- To pause ramp: `releasectl pause --release v3.5.0`
- To rollback to previous stable: `releasectl rollback --release v3.5.0 --to stable`
- Emergency hotfix flow: open PR to `release/v3.5.0` + `@sre` review, then `./deploy release/v3.5.0 --hotfix`.

Alex: Final TL;DR: freeze Wed 23:00 PT, canary Thu 09:00 PT, warmup before final flip, watch thresholds above. Ping me or @Sasha for rollout gate questions. :rocket: :lock:

Sasha: I'll drop the warmup job logs to this thread during the run and tag failures.

Ben: If anyone has last-minute dataset/feature flags to opt-out, comment here by Wed 16:00 PT.

Marta: ack — will flag one opt-out for the A/B cohort by EOD.

Alex: Thanks all — see you Thursday.
